title: The New Basement Tapes’ ‘Ted Lasso’ Synch Leads August 2026 Top TV Songs Chart
summary: “Kansas City” is No. 1 after being heard in the series’ season premiere.
contentText:
The return of Ted Lasso to television is heralded by its entry at No. 1 on Billboard ’s Top TV Songs chart, powered by Tunefind (a Songtradr company), for August 2026 via The New Basement Tapes’ “Kansas City.”

Rankings for the Top TV Songs chart are based on song and show data provided by Tunefind and ranked using a formula blending that data with sales and streaming information tracked by Luminate during the corresponding period of August 2026.

“Kansas City” can be heard in the fourth season premiere of Ted Lasso , which aired on Apple TV+ on Aug. 5. The episode served as somewhat of a series reboot for the show, with its titular character now coaching a women’s soccer team instead of a men’s program.

In August 2026, “Kansas City” — originally released in 2014 as part of The New Basement Tapes’ lone album Lost in the River: The New Basement Tapes — earned 1.9 million official streams and sold 1,000 downloads in the United States, according to Luminate. “Kansas City” was the album’s lead single in its time, peaking at No. 4 on Adult Alternative Airplay in 2015.

One of The New Basement Tapes’ writers/performers, Marcus Mumford (also of Mumford & Sons ), co-wrote and sings Ted Lasso ’s theme song. The supergroup also featured Elvis Costello , Jim James , Rhiannon Giddens and Dawes ‘ Taylor Goldsmith.

“Kansas City” reigns over a pair of songs from Prime Video’s Reacher, whose fourth season premiered Aug. 12. Pixies ’ “Where Is My Mind?” leads the duo (No. 2; 8 million streams, 1,000 downloads), followed by Black Sabbath ’s “Iron Man” (No. 3; 7.7 million streams, 1,000 downloads).

See the full chart, also featuring music from rookie series The Shards and Lanterns , plus Special Ops: Lioness , below.
